properties.SQL Query:
SELECT 
		COLUMN_ID AS "columnId",
        COLUMN_CD1 AS "columnCd1",
        EDI_CD1 AS "ediCd1"
		FROM  KR0001.B2_INTERFACE_CD_MP_TB
		WHERE CORP_ID = ${coCd}
			AND INTERFACE_ID = '*'
			AND USE_YN = 1
			AND (COLUMN_ID = 'DZ_ACCT_CD' AND COLUMN_CD1 = CAST('${acctCd}' AS VARCHAR(255))
		    OR  COLUMN_ID = 'DZ_TR_CD' AND COLUMN_CD1 = CAST('${trCd}' AS VARCHAR(255)) 
		    OR COLUMN_ID = 'DZ_CO_CD' AND COLUMN_CD1 = CAST('${coCd}' AS VARCHAR(255)))
